setting_baseURL_desp: The base URL of your vector index server.
setting_aboutTip_desp: This plugin provides vector search capabilities.
setting_cleanQueue_desp: Clear the current pending index tasks queue. Tasks currently being processed cannot be interrupted. This operation is irreversible.
setting_stopCycle_desp: Pause the currently executing background indexing tasks. Background indexing will resume after the next manual indexing or plugin restart.
setting_aboutChroma_desp: Chroma is an open-source vector embedding database.
setting_chroma.enabled_desp: Whether to enable the Chroma vector database feature.
setting_chroma.baseUrl_desp: The base API URL of the Chroma service, e.g., http://localhost:8000.
setting_chroma.headerJson_desp: Optional custom HTTP headers in JSON format.
setting_chatModel.modelType_desp: Select the provider type for the chat model.
setting_chatModel.modelType_option_oai_d: Use a model service compatible with the OpenAI API.
setting_chatModel.baseUrl_desp: The base URL for the chat model API.
setting_chatModel.apiKey_desp: The API key used to authenticate requests to the chat model.
setting_chatModel.modelName_desp: The specific chat model name to use, e.g., gpt-4o.
setting_chatModel.test_desp: Click to test if the configured chat model is available.
setting_embeddingModel.modelType_desp: Select the provider type for the embedding model.
setting_embeddingModel.modelType_option_: Use a model service compatible with the OpenAI Embedding API.
setting_embeddingModel.baseUrl_desp: The base URL for the embedding model API.
setting_embeddingModel.apiKey_desp: The API key used to authenticate requests to the embedding model.
setting_embeddingModel.modelName_desp: The specific embedding model name to use, e.g., text-embedding-ada-002.
setting_embeddingModel.test_desp: Click to test if the configured embedding model is available.
setting_rerankModel.modelType_desp: Select the provider type for the reranking model.
setting_rerankModel.modelType_option_qwe: Use Alibaba Cloud's Qwen reranking model.
setting_rerankModel.baseUrl_desp: The base URL for the reranking model API.
setting_rerankModel.apiKey_desp: The API key used to authenticate requests to the reranking model.
setting_rerankModel.modelName_desp: The specific reranking model name to use.
setting_rerankModel.test_desp: Click to test if the configured reranking model is available.
setting_chroma.test_desp: Test whether the connection to the Chroma vector database is working properly.
setting_chroma.useQuestionAbstract_desp: Use a language model to summarize the original content and generate questions to improve retrieval relevance.
setting_chroma.useRerankModel_desp: After retrieving results, use a reranking model to reorder them for improved accuracy.
setting_embeddingModel.maxInputsCount_de: The maximum number of text items that can be embedded in a single request.
setting_embeddingModel.maxTotalCharacter: The upper limit of total characters across all inputs in a single request.
setting_embeddingModel.maxSingleCharacte: The maximum number of characters allowed per input item in a single request.
setting_chroma.resetCollection_desp: Clear all data from the current Chroma collection. This action cannot be undone.
